verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports headless/CLI usage with auto-approve for automation, plus GitHub/Slack/Linear/webhook/schedule-triggered workflows and an API for scripting, indicating it can run non-interactively in pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example (e.g., GitHub Actions YAML, Jenkins integration) or documented exit-code/output contract for shell scripting. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI config), documented headless invocation flags/exit codes for shell scripting, independent confirmation of non-interactive batch runs.
